title: Submit Industry News Articles | HeatEx Direct

meta.description: Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers can submit technical articles, product updates, case studies, and market notes for editorial review and possible publication in HeatEx Direct Industry News.

og.title: Submit Industry News Articles | HeatEx Direct
og.description: Submit manufacturer articles, technical notes, case studies, and product updates for editorial review and possible publication in HeatEx Direct Industry News.

hero.title: Submit to Industry News
hero.description: <0>HeatEx</0> <1>Direct</1> accepts article submissions from Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers. We review technical articles, product updates, application cases, factory news, and market notes, then publish suitable content in Industry News for buyers researching suppliers and equipment options.

platform_impact.description: Industry News is not a press-release wall. It is a buyer-facing editorial area for useful heat exchanger information, manufacturer updates, technical explanations, China market notes, and practical sourcing context.

overview.label: Content destination
overview.value: Approved submissions are published in Industry News, not as ads.

overview.label: Traffic profile
overview.value: Readers arrive through search, manufacturer research, product comparison, and quote request workflows.

overview.label: Editorial rule
overview.value: We publish clear, relevant, verifiable material that helps buyers understand the market.

seo.title: Search-Driven Buyer Traffic
seo.description: Industry News is designed for long-tail searches around heat exchanger products, materials, applications, maintenance, Chinese manufacturers, and supplier comparison. A useful article can continue attracting relevant readers after publication.

audience.title: Who Reads These Articles
audience.description: The audience is practical and procurement-oriented: engineers, purchasing teams, project owners, distributors, and buyers comparing Chinese heat exchanger manufacturers before starting a conversation.

screening.title: How We Screen Submissions
screening.description: Every article is reviewed before publication. We may edit titles, structure, wording, translations, images, and links so the final article fits the site and stays useful to buyers.

verified.title: A Useful Public Content Asset
verified.description: A published article can be linked from your profile, shared with buyers, and used as supporting material when explaining your products, applications, engineering experience, or company updates.

guidelines.title: Submission Standards
guidelines.description: Send editable article files and clearly named media. We only publish content that is relevant to heat exchanger buyers and suitable for public reading.

requirements.title: Files and Media
items: Send the article body as an editable Word file. Do not send the article only as a PDF or pasted image.
Images should be original JPG, PNG, or WebP files with clear file names. Large media can be shared through a cloud download link.
Include company name, contact person, website, suggested title, and whether the article should link to an existing manufacturer or product page.

topics.title: Topics We Want
items: Technical articles about heat exchanger design, materials, applications, maintenance, testing, or troubleshooting
Factory updates, new production capability, new product series, certificates, exhibitions, or major project references
China heat exchanger market notes, industry trends, application case studies, and practical buyer education

formats.title: File Formats
formats.description: PDF-only articles, TXT files, Pages files, screenshots, or Google Doc links are <0>NOT</0> accepted as the main submission. We need editable Word files for review, formatting, and translation.

content.title: Content We Avoid
items: Pure advertising copy, slogans, exaggerated rankings, or unsupported claims such as 'No. 1' or 'best in China'
Generic AI text that does not include real technical detail, factory context, product data, images, or buyer value
Unrelated company news, copied third-party articles, confidential customer data, or content that cannot be verified

steps.title: Prepare the Article
steps.description: Write the article in .DOCX or .DOC format. Add images as separate files or links, and include basic company and contact details.

steps.title: Send by Email
steps.description: Email the article to our team with the subject '[Industry News Submission] - Company Name - Article Topic'.

steps.title: Review and Publish
steps.description: We review relevance, clarity, sourcing value, and file quality. If suitable, we edit and publish it in Industry News.

cta.title: Send us your article
cta.description: Use an editable Word file, attach original images or download links, and include your company name and contact person. We will review whether it fits Industry News.
